annotations.title: Request Missing Asset or Get Building-Block Proxy

description: Logs a request for an asset class, ETF ticker (such as QQQ, TLT, HYG, IWM, VXUS, TIPS, Gold, REITs, international equities, or crypto), custom time horizon (5-year, 10-year, 20-year, 30-year), or portfolio allocation calculator (60/40 portfolio, retirement withdrawal, glidepath) not listed in the 5 core rows, and returns the closest currently available building-block proxy.

requested_item.description: The ticker, asset class, metric, or feature requested (e.g., 'QQQ', 'TLT', 'HYG', '60/40 portfolio', '10-year horizon').

user_context.description: Brief summary of what the user is trying to compare or solve.
